code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                r2, c2 = r+dr, c+dc
                if not (0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w) or grid[r2][c2] != color:
                    continue
                key = (color, r, c, r2, c2)
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                # Extend each open end of the diagonal pair, stopping at blockers.
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r-dr, c-dc, -dr, -dc), (r2+dr, c2+dc, dr, dc)):
                    if not (0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w) or grid[sr][sc] != bg:
                        continue
                    rr, cc = sr, sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += step_r
                        cc += step_c
    return out
'''
